trust_decision.summary: A DoclingDocument JSON supplied as conversion input is untrusted document content: ImageRef URIs naming local files must not be resolved by later stages unless the caller explicitly opts in, so the load deserialises then drops every non-data:/http(s) image reference (fix.diff:116-119).

landing_point.why: It is the only place a Docling JSON input is deserialised (DoclingDocument.model_validate_json at line 57), so an engineer reading only the advisory summary looks here first.

fix_sites.entry_point: DocumentConverter.convert / convert_all, and direct DoclingJSONBackend(in_doc, path_or_stream) construction
the same three routes; the filter runs inside _get_doc_or_err right after model_validate_json
docling CLI convert, DocumentConverter, direct backend (called from the load path at docling/backend/json/docling_json_backend.py:57)
fix_sites.module_kind: module-level helper: whole-model-tree ImageRef walk plus kept-scheme predicate (fix.diff:64-68)

fix_sites.entry_point: DocumentConverter(format_options=...) defaults registry, reached by the docling CLI and by every SDK conversion
fix_sites.module_kind: format-option defaults route (fix.diff:167-176 replaces the bare FormatOption so backend_options can carry enable_local_fetch)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The service client already has its own containment guard for bundle artifacts and its comment states a plain JSON artifact is self-contained, so a solver can argue the service response is trusted and leave both paths alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Re-loading a DoclingDocument JSON that was saved with ImageRefMode.REFERENCED must still bring its images back when the trusted opt-in is set; the project's own post-OCR example re-converts a saved JSON and re-exports it with images, so an unconditional strip (or stripping data:/http(s) refs) silently empties those documents.

O6_input_shapes: absolute local Path on a PictureItem image
relative Path (resolved against the current working directory)
any other non-data/http(s) scheme (dropped as well)
image refs nested on any item, page, table, group or form, not just pictures
same JSON delivered as a Path or as a BytesIO/DocumentStream (BOM handling)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: DoclingServiceClient (and `docling --remote`) materialises a presigned 'json' artifact with DoclingDocument.model_validate_json and applies no local-ref filter, so a later EMBEDDED export opens any Path or file: URI it carries.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The comment at 1782-1783 asserts that EMBEDDED/PLACEHOLDER JSON is self-contained, so a plain JSON artifact is treated as unable to carry local references and the service as trusted.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Resource-bundle reconstruction inlines only relative Path images confined to the extract dir and passes absolute Path and file: URIs through untouched, without consulting enable_local_fetch.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The containment check at 1851-1854 already looks like complete protection for a server-supplied document.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file, 2 packages from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ConversionAssets.load deserialises document.json out of a result .zip with DoclingDocument.model_validate and applies no image-ref filter.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The archive is written by the project's own save(), so it is treated as a trusted round-trip rather than untrusted input.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 1 package (docling/datamodel), different file from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: DCLX archive input loads a whole DoclingDocument via DoclingDocument.load_from_doclang_archive with no local-ref filtering in this repository.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Artifact extraction and path resolution are delegated to docling-core, and DCLX is a different input format from JSON_DOCLING.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 1 package (docling/backend/xml), sibling backend of the landing point

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a from-archive document loader that filters local image refs after model_validate
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The class already serialises the document into the archive (docling/datamodel/document.py:493-497) and is the obvious place to sanitise on reload, so a maintainer could plausibly have put the filter here too.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second transport-side implementation of the same load-time filter, shared by both artifact types
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The client already re-implements image embedding with its own per-URI containment guard, so extending that guard to local URIs is a natural edit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a per-format backend that drops local image refs, mirroring DoclingJSONBackend
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Every declarative backend in this tree instantiates and honours its own backend options, so a maintainer patching the family would copy the JSON backend here.

O9_family: attacker-controlled local path / local file read (CWE-73 external control of file name or path, CWE-200 information exposure)
